# Counted lines reference

> **In 30 seconds.** Every counted line mango ships, with its one canonical grammar. Look up, don't
> read through. Source of truth: `python3 plugins/mango/scripts/check_lines.py grammars` — if this
> page and it disagree, it wins.

| Line | Emitted by | Required at | Canonical form |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BREAKDOWN` | breakdown | epic path | `BREAKDOWN: <N> tickets proposed \| <N> INVEST self-checks emitted (6 letters each) \| <f> tickets flagged for re-split` |
| `CHALLENGER VERDICT` | review | review | `CHALLENGER VERDICT: <n> requirement(s) rebuilt \| <m> met \| <x> not met \| <u> can't tell \| <g> not-met covered by a recorded exclusion` |
| `CLAIMS` | finalise, breakdown | finalise | `CLAIMS: <c> claim(s) from <e> lesson entr(ies) \| T1=<n> T2=<n> T3=<n> T4=<n> T5=<n> T6=<n> \| <u> unclassified` |
| `CLARIFICATION` | analysis | analysis | `CLARIFICATION: <M> raised \| <k> self-resolved (cited) \| <j> for human decision` |
| `DRIFT` | codify | conditional | `DRIFT: <n> entries \| <m> tickets` |
| `EXCLUSIONS` | design | design | `EXCLUSIONS: <n> recorded \| <e> with a checkable expiry \| <r> recurring (class seen ≥ 3 → discharged/escalated) \| <o> with an overdue predecessor \| <s> input-shape-dependent AC(s) \| <c> proven on a real corpus` |
| `FALSIFY` | finalise | finalise | `FALSIFY: <c> candidate(s) checked \| <t> still-true (proceed) \| <f> falsified (BLOCKED) \| <u> not cheaply checkable (BLOCKED)` |
| `HANDLES` | design | design | `HANDLES: <h> recalled \| <t> traced (command + result) \| <x> does not apply (reason) \| <u> unanswered` |
| `LEDGER TOTAL` | finalise | finalise | `LEDGER TOTAL: <tokens> · top cost driver: <phase/subagent>` |
| `PREMISE` | refine, analysis | refine | `PREMISE: <r> reference(s) checked \| <m> missing \| <a> ambiguous (surfaced, not blocking)` |
| `PREMISE FALSIFIED` | refine, analysis | conditional | `PREMISE FALSIFIED: <n> referenced-as-existing source(s) missing — <ref> (<ticket line naming it>), …` |
| `PROMOTE` | promote | conditional | `PROMOTE: <n> class(es) with recurrence >= 2 \| <p> candidate(s) proposed \| <e> already recorded (skipped) \| <b> blocked (reason) \| rules written: 0` |
| `PROMOTION` | finalise | finalise | `PROMOTION: <p> proposed \| <k> human-ratified \| destinations: <path>, … \| mango files written: 0` |
| `PROOF` | review (proof.py) | review (`PROTOCOL: v0.2` docs) | `PROOF: <n> proving test(s) \| <p> proven \| <r> regression-guard \| <z> green@base \| <e> env-fault@base \| <g> not green@head \| <f> flaky \| <c> could-not-run` |
| `RECALL` | refine, analysis, quick | refine | `RECALL: <n> claim(s) surfaced \| <s> by symbol \| <h> by handle \| <a> by area \| <f> by finding \| <r> retired skipped — advisory (blocks nothing)` |
| `RECURRENCE` | finalise | finalise | `RECURRENCE: <n> recurring \| <s> superseded (<r> retired) \| <p> promotion candidate(s)` |
| `RECURRING-T2` | finalise | finalise | `RECURRING-T2: <n> type-2 claim(s) with seen ≥ 2 \| <d> routed to a destination \| <b> cannot promote (reason) \| <l> left in lessons_path` |
| `REFINE` | refine | refine | `REFINE: <U> unresolved surfaced \| <a> want-decision asked \| <b> how-decision resolved+cited \| <s> ASSUMED \| skip: yes/no` |
| `RETIRE` | promote | conditional | `RETIRE: <o> offered \| <a> retired on the human's answer \| <s> declined/unanswered \| records deleted: 0` |
| `RULE SECTIONS` | analysis, quick | analysis | `RULE SECTIONS: <n> applicable — <k> by change-type \| <m> by recalled handle — §<id> (<source>) ✅ <what it constrains>, §<id> (<source>) N/A because <reason>, …` |
| `SECTIONS` | analysis | analysis | `SECTIONS: <n> found (names) \| <n> decomposed \| ROWS: C=.. R=.. G=.. AC=..` |
| `SURFACES` | analysis | conditional | `SURFACES: <N> — <surface>, <surface>, …` |
